item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed, leaning no. There is real 2024 evidence of technocratic capacity-building in health financing, public administration, procurement, and social protection, but the strongest operational evidence around food aid and humanitarian access points to capture, diversion, and coercive interference rather than clean professional management.

**Positive Evidence**
- **[Ethiopia - Governance Modernization to Enable Efficient Service Delivery Project](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099082124120033234)** | World Bank | 2024-08-16 | The project’s objective is to improve government capacity to mobilize and manage public financial and human resources efficiently, with components on public administration, HRM, finance, procurement, and core systems. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `5B.10`
- **[ILO trains social health protection actors in Ethiopia](https://ethiopia.un.org/en/277133-ilo-trains-social-health-protection-actors-ethiopia)** | United Nations in Ethiopia / ILO | 2024-07-19 | Policymakers and administrators overseeing Ethiopia’s social health protection programs received capacity-building on health financing and social protection systems. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **[Ethiopia](https://www.who.int/about/accountability/results/who-results-report-2024-2025/country-profile/2024/ethiopia)** | World Health Organization | 2024 | WHO says Ethiopia’s PHC framework was developed through a multisectoral process involving government, development partners, academia, and the private sector, to strengthen UHC, governance, workforce, and transparent procurement. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **[World Bank backs Ethiopia’s reforms to promote sustainable and inclusive growth](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/30/world-bank-backs-ethiopia-s-reforms-to-promote-sustainable-and-inclusive-afe-growth)** | World Bank | 2024-07-30 | The reform package explicitly aims to expand social safety nets, improve public-spending effectiveness, and protect poor and vulnerable households. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`, `5B.10`
- **[Second Phase of PROSPECTS Launched in Ethiopia, Empowering Refugees, IDPs and Host Communities](https://www.unicef.org/ethiopia/press-releases/second-phase-prospects-launched-ethiopia-empowering-refugees-idps-and-host)** | UNICEF Ethiopia | 2024-03-21 | The program targets education, livelihoods, protection, and infrastructure for refugees, IDPs, and host communities. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- **[Ethiopia's health-financing progress](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5233579)** | ENA English | 2024-10-03 | The ministry said health insurance coverage improved and financial barriers to primary care fell, indicating some professionalized health-financing management. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **[Ethiopia Considers Social Protection as Core Component of National Dev’t: Minister](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5452428)** | ENA English | 2024-11-13 | Social protection was described as remaining central to policy, which is at least consistent with prioritizing formal social-service administration. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`
- **[Social Health Protection training equips Ethiopian social health protection actors](https://www.ilo.org/resource/news/ilo-trains-social-health-protection-actors-ethiopia)** | International Labour Organization | 2024-07-12 | EHIS, MoH, regional bureaus, and other stakeholders were trained to strengthen health financing and social protection systems, with explicit capacity-building for staff. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`

**Negative Evidence**
- **[World Report 2024: Ethiopia](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-12 | HRW said a coordinated food-aid diversion scheme led WFP and USAID to halt aid, restricting food access for about 20 million people. That looks like capture or patronage-type interference rather than competent service management. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`, `5B.8`
- **[WASH - Gap Analysis for Refugees](https://data.unhcr.org/en/documents/details/107435)** | UNHCR | 2024-03-21 | Refugees were receiving about 14 liters of water per person per day, below the 20-liter minimum standard, showing service under-delivery in a vulnerable population. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- **[Nearly 1 million refugees in Ethiopia risk limited assistance due unprecedented funding crisis](https://www.unhcr.org/africa/news/press-releases/nearly-1-million-refugees-ethiopia-risk-limited-assistance-due-unprecedented)** | UNHCR Africa | 2024-04-15 | UNHCR warned that healthcare, education, and water gaps were directly harming refugees, with assistance limited by funding shortfalls. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `6B.3`
- **[Ethiopia: Army attacks health care in Amhara conflict](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/03/ethiopia-army-attacks-health-care-amhara-conflict)** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-07-03 | Security forces seized ambulances, raided hospitals, and assaulted medical staff, interfering with access to care and humanitarian operations. | `6B.4`, `6B.2`, `5B.9`
- **[Ethiopia: Mass arbitrary detentions in Amhara region deepen erosion of rule of law](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/10/ethiopia-mass-arbitrary-detentions-in-amhara-region-deepen-erosion-of-rule-of-law/)** | Amnesty International | 2024-10-01 | Mass detentions without warrants or timely court appearance suggest a coercive, politicized environment rather than professionally managed social services. | `6B.4`, `6B.1`, `5B.9`
- **[Ethiopia extends state of emergency in Amhara](https://kelo.com/2024/02/02/ethiopia-extends-state-of-emergency-in-amhara/)** | Reuters via KELO | 2024-02-02 | Emergency rule amid insurgency and abuse allegations signals a governance environment that is poor for impartial service delivery and professional administration. | `6B.4`, `5B.9`, `6B.2`

**Search Gap**
- The strongest positive evidence is institutional and programmatic: capacity-building, technical assistance, governance reform, and multisectoral planning.
- Direct proof that Abiy systematically replaced patronage networks with professional managers inside social-service ministries is thin.
- The clearest negative evidence comes from aid diversion and conflict disruption, not from a clean smoking gun showing patronage appointments in every service sector.
